Needs changes before merge.

This review ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-2875`, trial-merged with `upstream/main` (`5fdbed9bd8e7a8bb28e6f162a02ab423842b77e8`) with no conflicts. This review used no GitHub runner. This PR changes UI code only, not posted G-code, collision checks, stock simulation, or geometry.

### What looks good

- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tool_settings.rs` gives the Properties tool page its own scroll area and keeps `Apply` or `Add tool` beside `Close`.
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/pages.rs` shows `ErrorScope::Tool` messages above `Close` in `tool_shape_editor_window`.
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tool_body_page.rs`, `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tool_body_lathe_page.rs`, `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tool_holder_picker.rs`, and `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tool_settings_grid.rs` align the remaining rows label-left and replace raw state words with plain English.
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tool_profile_page.rs` calls `state.sync_tool_profile_ui()` before it draws the holder picker.
- `docs/decisions/2007-tool-editor-footer-plain-state.md` records the design choices and the dropped scope in the required format.
- This PR changes no snapshot PNGs, no golden `.nc` or `.cl` files, and no process files.
- All UI edits still go through undoable commands, and no `unwrap()`, `expect()`, or `panic!()` appears outside tests.

### Results merged with main

Ran locally against `upstream/main` (`5fdbed9bd8e7a8bb28e6f162a02ab423842b77e8`):

Extra suites run:

- None required. The diff changes no files under `testdata/`, no fixture or golden directories, and no STEP or mesh importer code.

### Requested before merge

1. **Add before and after screenshots to the PR body.** This PR changes the UI in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/pages.rs:107`, `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tool_settings.rs:14`, `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tool_settings_grid.rs:212`, `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tool_body_page.rs:70`, `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tool_body_lathe_page.rs:31`, and `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tool_holder_picker.rs:28`, but the PR body has no screenshots. Capture before and after images for the Properties tool page and the `Tool shape` window. Upload those images only to the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch, and link them in the PR body. Do not commit images to the PR branch.
2. **Fix the empty tool name in `tool_settings::page` when the new-tool form matches an existing tool.** In `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tool_settings.rs:53-68`, collapsing the `if name.is_empty()` branch into the shared path creates a bug when `state.new_tool_form` is true (`name` is `""`). If the user enters the name of an existing tool in `Name`, `state.sync_tool_ui()` sets `state.tool_ui.exists = true` while `name` stays `""`. Then line 54 renders `"Tool: "`, line 58 pushes `CommandKind::DeleteTool(String::new())`, and line 67 calls `actions::open_tool_shape_editor(state, "")`. Guard the existing-tool heading and buttons with `!name.is_empty()`, or use the resolved `state.tool_ui.name` consistently, and add a pinning test for this path.

### Questions / notes

- **Accessible label on `Library holder` (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/tool_holder_picker.rs:28-40`).** Changing `ComboBox::from_label("Library holder")` to `prop_row` with `ComboBox::from_id_salt("tool_library_holder")` removes the accessible label from the combo box. Consider calling `.labelled_by(label_id)` with `super::layout::row_label_id(ui)` (as `tool_body_assembly_page.rs:49-51` does) on `Library holder`, `Tool axis`, and `Body frame`.
- **Footer height reserve with long errors (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/tool_settings.rs:40-46`, `crates/ui/src/egui_app/pages.rs:508`).** When an `ErrorScope::Tool` message exceeds 80 characters, `error_text` wraps and adds a `Copy` button. The fixed 68 px or 72 px reserve can be too short in narrow panes.
- **Line count growth on files already over 400 lines.** `crates/ui/src/egui_app/pages.rs` (724 lines), `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tool_profile_page.rs` (412 lines), and `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/tool_body.rs` (484 lines) already exceed 400 lines and grow slightly. This note is not blocking.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
